description: This Python script generates reStructuredText documentation pages for examples in the Kivy framework, including a gallery page, detail pages for each example, and an index. It processes screenshot files and source code files to create documentation with links, images, and references.

methods.name: iter_filename_info
methods.description: Yields dictionaries with information about each PNG screenshot file matching a specific pattern in a directory.

methods.name: parse_docstring_info
methods.description: Parses a docstring from text to extract title, description, and first sentence.

methods.name: iter_docstring_info
methods.description: Iterates over screenshot files, reads associated source files, and yields info dictionaries with parsed docstrings.

methods.name: enhance_info_description
methods.description: Enhances the description in info dict by wrapping text and adding file references and links.

methods.name: get_infos
methods.description: Collects, sorts, and enhances info dictionaries for all relevant files in a directory.

methods.name: make_gallery_page
methods.description: Generates reStructuredText for the gallery page listing all examples.

methods.name: make_detail_page
methods.description: Generates reStructuredText for a detailed page of a specific example.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Writes a string to a specified filename, creating directories if needed.

methods.name: make_index
methods.description: Creates an index reStructuredText page linking to all example pages.

methods.name: write_all_rst_pages
methods.description: Main function that generates and writes all documentation pages.
